title: Find an artifact introduction
responsibility: Report a creation commit only when bounded artifact history shows one complete introduction.

inputs.name: hubArtifactCommit.context
inputs.description: The context object supplying source.historyPage, repository, and commit for the history request. If source.historyPage is absent, the function returns null without making a request.

inputs.name: hubArtifactCommit.path
inputs.description: The artifact path passed as the only entry in the history request paths array. The implementation does not validate or normalize the path.

outputs.name: hubArtifactCommit
outputs.description: The history hash is returned only when the result is complete and contains exactly one commit; otherwise the result is null. The request uses this path, page 1, and a limit of two entries, and missing history support also returns null.

errors.name: source.historyPage rejection
errors.description: An error thrown by source.historyPage or a rejection from its returned promise rejects hubArtifactCommit; the function does not catch or transform the failure.
